name.text: Calculating geometric probability using areas of shapes

questiontext.text:
A chicken wanders randomly around a square yard with side length {@s@} m. It is equally likely to be at any point in the yard at any moment.

The farmer has drawn a circle of radius {@r@} m centred in the middle of the yard. There is also a small rectangular corner pen located at the top right, with a width of {@w@} m and a height of {@h@} m.

[[jsxgraph width="400px" height="400px"]] var s = {#s#}; var r = {#r#}; var w = {#w#}; var h_pen = {#h#}; var brd = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-1.5, s + 1.5, s + 1.5, -1.5], axis: false, grid: false, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false, pan: {enabled: false}, zoom: {enabled: false} }); /* Draw the main square yard */ var yard = brd.create('polygon', [[0, 0], [s, 0], [s, s], [0, s]], { fixed: true, fillColor: '#e0e0e0', fillOpacity: 0.5, borders: {strokeWidth: 2, strokeColor: '#424242'}, vertices: {visible: false} }); /* Draw the central circular region */ var center = brd.create('point', [s/2, s/2], {fixed: true, visible: true, name: '', size: 2, color: '#0d47a1'}); var circle = brd.create('circle', [center, r], { fixed: true, fillColor: '#bbdefb', fillOpacity: 0.7, strokeWidth: 2, strokeColor: '#1976d2' }); /* Draw the rectangular corner pen */ var pen = brd.create('polygon', [[s-w, s-h_pen], [s, s-h_pen], [s, s], [s-w, s]], { fixed: true, fillColor: '#ffe0b2', fillOpacity: 0.8, borders: {strokeWidth: 2, strokeColor: '#f57c00'}, vertices: {visible: false} }); /* Add labels directly to the canvas */ brd.create('text', [s/2, -0.6, s.toString() + ' m'], {fixed: true, anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 14, strokeColor: '#424242'}); brd.create('text', [-0.6, s/2, s.toString() + ' m'], {fixed: true, anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 14, strokeColor: '#424242', display: 'internal', rotate: 90}); brd.create('text', [s/2, s/2 - r*0.4, 'circle'], {fixed: true, anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 14, strokeColor: '#0d47a1'}); brd.create('text', [s - w/2, s - h_pen/2, 'pen'], {fixed: true, anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 14, strokeColor: '#e65100'}); /* Draw radius line */ brd.create('segment', [[s/2, s/2], [s/2 + r, s/2]], {fixed: true, strokeColor: '#1976d2', strokeWidth: 1}); brd.create('text', [s/2 + r/2, s/2 + 0.3, r.toString() + ' m'], {fixed: true, anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'bottom', fontSize: 12, strokeColor: '#1976d2'}); [[/jsxgraph]]

a) What is the total area of the yard?

\(\text{Total Area} =\) [[input:ans1]] \(\text{m}^2\)

[[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

b) What is the exact area of the circular region? (Leave your answer in terms of \(\pi\). Type pi to enter \(\pi\)).

\(\text{Circle Area} =\) [[input:ans2]] \(\text{m}^2\)

[[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

c) Since the chicken is equally likely to be anywhere, what is the probability that at a random moment the chicken is inside the circular region?

(Enter your answer as an exact fraction involving \(\pi\). Type pi to enter \(\pi\)).

\(P(\text{inside circle}) =\) [[input:ans3]]

[[validation:ans3]] [[feedback:prt3]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution:

Part a: Total Area
The yard is a square with side length \(s = {@s@}\) m. The area of a square is \(s^2\).

\(\text{Total Area} = {@s@} \times {@s@} = {@ta1@}\text{ m}^2\)

Part b: Favourable Area
The circular region has a radius \(r = {@r@}\) m. The area of a circle is \(\pi r^2\).

\(\text{Circle Area} = \pi \times {@r@}^2 = {@r^2@}\pi\text{ m}^2\)

Part c: Geometric Probability
Geometric probability is calculated as the ratio of the favourable area to the total area:

\( \displaystyle P = \frac{\text{Area of favourable region}}{\text{Total area}} \)

\( \displaystyle P(\text{inside circle}) = \frac{{@r^2@}\pi}{{@ta1@}} \)

\( \displaystyle \boxed{ P = {@ta3@} } \)

questionnote.text: Square: s={@s@}, Area={@ta1@}. Circle: r={@r@}, Area={@ta2@}. P(circle)={@ta3@}
